key_insight: Fine-tuned MACE simulations reveal a shift from localized Li⁺ motion below 500 K to contrasting high-temperature dynamics near 800 K, with competing Li⁺ and framework motions at 500–700 K.
engineering_relevance: Resolving how framework motion influences lithium-ion dynamics could guide solid-electrolyte design for batteries.
method: Run molecular dynamics with a fine-tuned MACE interatomic potential for Li₆PS₅Cl.
Analyze dynamical eigenspectra and low-dimensional trajectory embeddings using essential dynamics.
Use Langevin dynamics to test how damping framework motion affects Li⁺ dynamics.
evidence_signal: Eigenspectra and trajectory embeddings show nonmonotonic temperature dependence at 500–700 K, while framework-damping simulations support competition between Li⁺ and framework motions.
watch_item: The abstract provides no quantitative potential-validation errors, leaving accuracy across temperatures and dynamical regimes to be checked.
paper_title: Temperature-Dependent Ion Dynamics in Argyrodite Superionic Conductor Li$_{6}$PS$_{5}$Cl with Fine-Tuned MACE Foundation Model
